enderal-magic-porter
docs.description: Port Skyrim SE SPELL and magic mods into Enderal SE. Use after skyrim-to-enderal-porter has cleared the generic kill-checks, for everything magic-specific — renaming the five schools and the Elder Scrolls gods out of the strings, distributing spell tomes and scrolls through Enderal's own lists and merchants, repricing BOTH the gold and the mana costs onto Enderal's scale (a ported spell's mana cost is the Creation Kit's arithmetic, not the author's design, and it makes the top tier uncastable), and making self-heals pay Arcane Fever. Every rule here was paid for by the Apocalypse and Triumvirate ports.

docs.title: papyrus-script-engineer
docs.description: SkyrimSE Papyrus scripting expert. Use to clean up Champollion-decompiled .psc, fix compile errors, write/edit Papyrus scripts, and drive the extract→decompile→edit→compile→package loop for this workspace.

agent_meta.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash

docs.title: skyrim-to-enderal-porter
docs.description: Triage and port Skyrim SE mods to Enderal SE. Use FIRST, before planning or authoring anything, whenever a Skyrim mod is being brought into Enderal — it runs the cheap kill-checks (form version, SKSE build, masters, distribution, worldspace/record collisions) that decide whether a mod is portable at all and whether it needs a patch or a replacement plugin.

docs.title: spriggit-formkey-auditor
docs.description: Read-only auditor for the SkyrimSE Spriggit YAML workspace. Use to scan for FormID/FormKey collisions, dangling master references, broken cross-record invariants (parallel-array lengths, linked spell/MGEF/perk sets), and known in-game anti-patterns before deserializing or shipping. Reports findings; never edits.

docs.title: spriggit-record-editor
docs.description: SkyrimSE Spriggit/Mutagen YAML record expert. Use to create or edit plugin records (Activators, MagicEffects, Quests, Perks, Spells, etc.) directly in the Spriggit YAML, following this workspace's naming and FormKey conventions. Invoke when the user wants to add/modify records, wire up cross-record links, or build a feature in the plugin's YAML.

agent_meta.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash

docs.title: Extract from a .bsa / .ba2 archive (bsab.exe)
docs.description: Extract or list files (especially scripts) from a Bethesda .bsa/.ba2 archive using the BSA Browser CLI (bsab.exe). Use when the user wants to pull .pex scripts (or any assets) out of a .bsa/.ba2, or inspect what an archive contains.

docs.title: FormKey collision check
docs.description: Check the SkyrimSE Spriggit workspace for FormID/FormKey collisions before assigning a new one, or find the next free FormID block. Use when the user is about to create a record, asks "is this FormID free", "what's the next free FormKey", or wants a collision audit.

docs.title: Cut a GitHub release
docs.description: Cut a versioned GitHub release (e.g. v1.2.0) for this mod — build a changelog from the previous tag, push the version tag so CI builds and publishes the assets, then replace the generated notes with the curated changelog and mark it Latest. Use when the user wants to "make a release", "cut vX.Y.Z", or "publish a release".

docs.title: Magic extract — load-order-winning magic values
docs.description: Regenerate arch-docs/magic/ — every magic record in the installed Zenderal modlist (SPEL/MGEF/ENCH/SCRL/ALCH/SHOU/LVSP/GMST) with load-order-WINNING values as JSON/CSV/Markdown. Use after any modlist change, or when the user asks what a spell's actual in-game values are, wants the magic dataset refreshed, or is rebalancing magic.

docs.title: Deploy to an MO2 modlist (and verify it landed)
docs.description: Deploy the packaged mod from dist/<ModName>/ into an MO2 modlist's mods folder and verify it actually landed under the exact expected name. Use when the user wants to install, deploy, or test the built mod in a modlist, or asks why their change isn't showing up in-game.

docs.title: Scaffold a new plugin
docs.description: Scaffold a brand-new plugin in this workspace — a Spriggit YAML folder with a correct header and a build/manifest.json entry (plus a FOMOD only if the install has options) — so it is buildable and CI-packaged from the first commit. Use when the user wants to start a new mod, add a second plugin, or add a compatibility patch to an existing mod.

docs.title: Install a Wabbajack modlist & wire it into the workspace
docs.description: Install a Wabbajack (.wabbajack) SkyrimSE modlist into a gitignored location and auto-discover its tool paths (Creation Kit, Papyrus compiler, game folder, xEdit, etc.) into .claude/config/tools.json. Use when the user wants to set up a modlist, point the workspace at an installed modlist, install a .wabbajack file, or stop using hardcoded tool paths.

docs.title: Package a loose mod for MO2 testing
docs.description: Assemble a loose SkyrimSE mod folder (the .esp plus compiled scripts and optional source) in Data layout, ready to install and test in an MO2 modlist. Use when the user wants to package their plugin + scripts into an installable/testable mod.

docs.title: Compile .psc → .pex (PapyrusCompiler.exe)
docs.description: Compile Papyrus source (.psc) into bytecode (.pex) using the Creation Kit's command-line PapyrusCompiler.exe. Use when the user wants to build/compile scripts for SkyrimSE without opening the Creation Kit GUI.

docs.title: Decompile .pex → .psc (Champollion)
docs.description: Decompile compiled Papyrus bytecode (.pex) back into readable source (.psc) using Champollion. Use after extracting .pex files from a .bsa or from loose Scripts, when the user wants editable Papyrus source.

docs.title: Spriggit: Decompile a reference master (lookup only)
docs.description: Serialize a vanilla or third-party SkyrimSE plugin into the gitignored reference/ folder for FormKey lookups only. Use when the user wants to decompile Skyrim.esm, Update.esm, a DLC, or another mod purely for reference/lookup (not to edit or commit).

docs.title: Spriggit: Deserialize (YAML → plugin)
docs.description: Rebuild a Bethesda plugin (.esp/.esm/.esl) from its Spriggit YAML folder in this SkyrimSE workspace. Use when the user wants to deserialize, re-pack, build, or compile the plugin from the edited YAML.

docs.title: Spriggit: Serialize (plugin → YAML)
docs.description: Serialize a Bethesda plugin (.esp/.esm/.esl) into an editable Spriggit YAML folder for this SkyrimSE workspace. Use when the user wants to decompile/convert a plugin to text, import a plugin into the workspace, or "serialize" a mod.
